disarmGlitch

Stops the loop and removes the overlay.

attachGlitch

Binds the always-on glitch: starts the arm poll immediately (the effect runs ambient interference as soon as the portrait decodes — no hover needed) and the delegated hover handlers that only flip the intensity flag. Listeners live on the shadow root, so they survive _updateDom re-renders.
